name: K4 Incidence with Empty Set
definition: Let $V=\{a,b,c,d\}$ and let $X=\binom V2$ be the six unordered edges of the complete graph $K_4$. For $v\in V$ define $h_v:X\to\{0,1\}$ by $h_v(e)=1$ exactly when $v\in e$. Let $h_0$ be the all-zero function on $X$. The **K4 incidence class with the empty set** is $\mathcal I_{K_4}=\{h_0,h_a,h_b,h_c,h_d\}$. Equivalently, its concepts are the empty edge set and the four three-edge vertex stars. This is one fixed five-concept class on six coordinates, not an asymptotic family.
comments: Proper unlabeled compression and proper stable unlabeled compression are both three, whereas proper equivalence-query complexity is two. Thus the exact query upper bound fails even when proper stable schemes exist. This finite 3-versus-2 gap does not refute an affine or unspecified functional bound.
